lines.cap: This alien studied humans for one day. He quit.
lines.say: This alien studied humans for one day. He quit.

lines.cap: Day one. First stop, a bus queue.
lines.say: Day one. First stop, a bus queue.

lines.cap: Forty humans. Standing still. For a bus that is not coming.
lines.say: Forty humans. Standing still. For a bus that is not coming.

lines.cap: He has said five minutes for one hour.
lines.say: He has said five minutes for one hour.

lines.cap: She was this small! Now look at her!
lines.say: She was this small! Now look at her!

lines.cap: The large one is leaking. Is he in danger?
lines.say: The large one is leaking. Is he in danger?

lines.cap: And you, beta? When is your wedding?
lines.say: And you, beta? When is your wedding?

lines.cap: I am four hundred years old. Abort mission.
lines.say: I am four hundred years old. Abort mission.

lines.cap: Back on the ship, he files his report.
lines.say: Back on the ship, he files his report.

lines.cap: Humans wait in lines. They leak at parties. They ask strangers when they will marry.
lines.say: Humans wait in lines. They leak at parties. They ask strangers when they will marry.

lines.cap: Then the boss starts crying. At the report.
lines.say: Then the boss starts crying. At the report.

lines.cap: Tag the human who'd confuse an alien. This alien studied humans for one day. He quit.
lines.say: Tag the human who'd confuse an alien. This alien studied humans for one day. He quit.
